buildStep: none - perchance compiles main.pjs + index.html server-side at request time

external-code.role: third-party runtime injected by the platform; not authored here, not bundleable

notes: No {import:...} statements are used, so there are no vendored dependencies.
No images, audio, video, fonts, models, shaders or JSON data assets are referenced.
AGENTS.md in the workspace is AI-agent harness documentation, not part of the generator.
Deploy = paste main.pjs into the code editor and index.html into the HTML editor of the target generator.
